Tess (People Ops): Omar flagged a ride-share charge from Singapore that shows as SGD on the card but the driver gave a paper receipt and the in-app refund was issued later. He uploaded the card posting and a photo of the tiny receipt but the amounts don't match exactly due to rounding. Can we accept this?
Omar: The app charged SGD 22.30, my card posted USD 16.87, driver receipt says SGD 22.20 (small paper receipt). I also have an in-app message showing a SGD 0.50 refund for a tip adjustment.
Finance Ops: We need converging evidence: (1) in-app trip record or screenshot showing trip ID and amounts, (2) card statement showing the USD posting, and (3) any physical receipt. When small rounding/refund diffs exist, explain in the expense comment how amounts net.
Travel Desk: If there's an in-app refund, attach the app chat/email confirming the refund and the final net amount. Also attach the exchange rate or let us use the posted USD.
Omar: Ok I can attach three screenshots: app trip detail, card posting (redacted PAN), and the paper receipt. What's the exact wording approvers should look for?
Tess (People Ops): Ask Omar to add a one-line attestation like: "Trip on 2026-06-05, SG ride from hotel to client HQ. App charged SGD 22.30; driver receipt SGD 22.20; card posted USD 16.87 after exchange; app issued SGD 0.50 refund for tip. I confirm net reimbursable equals USD 16.87. - Omar"
Expense Bot: Tip: filename pattern 2026-06-05-sg-ride-app.png, accepted types jpg/png/pdf. Redact full PAN. If you upload multiple images, label them in the expense comment (app, card, paper receipt).
Finance Ops: Also: if the card posted amount differs from the sum of itemized receipts (refunds, tips), we reimburse the bank-posted USD unless employee requests reimbursement based on original local currency amounts. If reimbursing local currency, include OANDA rate screenshot for that date.
Tess (People Ops): One more edge case  if the driver handed a receipt with no vendor name (just handwriting), ask for the app trip ID and a manager confirmation if the amounts still don't reconcile.
Omar: I'll re-upload with the attestation and app chat screenshot. Thanks everyone.
Tess (People Ops): Great  Ill paste the attestation template into the receipts wiki and add a one-line checklist for foreign ride-share rounding issues. :white_check_mark:
